Intel Corporation is hiring an Automated Material Handling Systems Software Engineer for its Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona. The role designs, develops, tests, and sustains software supporting automated movement and storage of semiconductor wafers and reticles, while integrating systems, troubleshooting operational issues, and improving reliability across manufacturing operations.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, validate, debug, and sustain software solutions that support automated material handling and storage systems across the Ocotillo campus
Support the integration, installation, qualification, and startup of AMHS and manufacturing equipment for Fab 62 and campus-wide operations
Enable reliable automated movement and storage of semiconductor wafers and reticles throughout the OTF campus, ensuring operational continuity and production readiness
Collaborate with manufacturing customers, operations teams, and project stakeholders to identify requirements and deliver effective automation solutions
Partner with the AMHS Command Center and Project Management Office (PMO) to troubleshoot operational issues, manage escalations, and drive timely resolution of system events
Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to continuously improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability
Work cross-functionally with Intel Foundry Automation organizations and external suppliers to support ongoing system enhancements and operational excellence
Participate in an on-call rotation supporting a 24x7 high-availability automation environment, with flexibility to adjust scheduled hours to support new factory project milestones
